title: Block Towers
statementMd:
Students in a class are making towers of blocks. Each student makes a (non-zero) tower by stacking pieces lengthwise on top of each other. $*n*$ of the students use pieces made of two blocks and $*m*$ of the students use pieces made of three blocks.

The students don’t want to use too many blocks, but they also want to be unique, so no two students’ towers may contain the same number of blocks. Find the minimum height necessary for the tallest of the students' towers.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two space-separated integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($0 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 1 000 000$, $*n* + *m* > 0$) — the number of students using two-block pieces and the number of students using three-block pieces, respectively.

## Output

Print a single integer, denoting the minimum possible height of the tallest tower.

## Note

In the first case, the student using two-block pieces can make a tower of height $4$, and the students using three-block pieces can make towers of height $3$, $6$, and $9$ blocks. The tallest tower has a height of $9$ blocks.

In the second case, the students can make towers of heights $2$, $4$, and $8$ with two-block pieces and towers of heights $3$ and $6$ with three-block pieces, for a maximum height of $8$ blocks.
statementZhMd:
学生们正在用积木搭塔。每名学生通过将若干块积木纵向堆叠在一起，搭建一座（非零高度的）塔。其中 $*n*$ 名学生使用由两块积木组成的部件，$*m*$ 名学生使用由三块积木组成的部件。

学生们不想使用太多积木，但他们也希望各不相同，因此任意两名学生搭建的塔中都不能包含相同数量的积木。求所有学生搭建的塔中最高塔所需的最小高度。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$0 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 1 000 000$，$*n* + *m* > 0$）——分别表示使用两块积木部件和三块积木部件的学生人数。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示最高塔可能达到的最小高度。

## 说明

在第一种情况中，使用两块积木部件的学生可以搭建高度为 $4$ 的塔，使用三块积木部件的学生可以搭建包含 $3$、$6$ 和 $9$ 块积木的塔。最高塔的高度为 $9$ 块积木。

在第二种情况中，学生们可以使用两块积木部件搭建高度为 $2$、$4$ 和 $8$ 的塔，并使用三块积木部件搭建高度为 $3$ 和 $6$ 的塔，因此最高塔的高度为 $8$ 块积木。
